analysis.original_request: 我正在为燃气轮机和工业烟气在线监测系统设计一个共享前端红外滤光膜。探测器需要同时通过一氧化碳 4.55–4.75 μm 和二氧化碳 4.15–4.35 μm 两个窄波段的辐射，并在 3.60–4.00 μm 以及 4.85–5.20 μm 范围内抑制背景和其他热辐射。请在空气正入射、CaF2 基底条件下，设计一个不含金属层、仅使用常规可沉积红外无机介质材料的平面多层膜，膜系总层数不超过 24 层。
analysis.normalized_request_english: Design a shared front-end infrared filter coating for gas turbine and industrial flue gas online monitoring systems. The detector needs to transmit radiation in two narrow bands: CO at 4.55–4.75 μm and unspecified material at 4.15–4.35 μm, while suppressing background and other thermal radiation in the ranges 3.60–4.00 μm and 4.85–5.20 μm. Design a planar multilayer film under unspecified material on a CaF2 substrate, using no metal layers, only conventional depositable infrared inorganic dielectric materials, with a total layer count not exceeding 24 layers.
analysis.compatibility_reason: Planar multilayer dielectric filter design fits within linear isotropic layered media solver scope.
preferred_behaviors: high transmittance in 4.15-4.35 um and 4.55-4.75 um bands
low transmittance in 3.60-4.00 um and 4.85-5.20 um bands
design_variables: material selection from conventional IR dielectrics
manufacturing_constraints: conventional depositable infrared inorganic dielectric materials
ambiguities: specific dielectric material candidates not specified
method_research_questions: selection of optimal material pair for IR range
thickness optimization strategy for dual-band pass with stopbands
